gaps.target: Identify the photoconductive layer, electrodes and supporting/protective structure in the labeled LDR construction diagram.
gaps.whyUnique: Current Q01 tests the resistance trend and Q02 tests transduction, not which labeled parts conduct, support or cover the sensor. One source-scoped diagram-role extension can close this; do not invent material specifications or demand separate cold-weld trivia.

gaps.target: Distinguish the internal reed/contact material and blades from glass capsule, inert gas and glass-to-metal bond shown in the actual diagram.
gaps.whyUnique: Existing items assess the magnetic stimulus, wheel-event arithmetic and polling/debounce, not the labeled enclosed construction. Do not invent gas chemistry or unprinted service-life guarantees.

gaps.target: Assess the slide-attributed internal analog conversion to digital data followed by single-wire serial transmission, as distinct from the preceding raw analog-read sensors and from I2C.
gaps.whyUnique: The existing quantity, documentation-revision, pin/NTC and library-order items do not test the internal ADC/interface chain. Retain the separate humidity-element revision qualification.

gaps.target: Interpret the source-attributed humidity-sensor exploded diagram: moisture-holding substrate between upper and lower electrodes above the glass substrate.
gaps.whyUnique: Current Q01 assesses the NTC curve and connector pins, not the other half of the figure. Do not assert this architecture for every DHT11 hardware revision.

gaps.target: Connect the listed capacitive low-noise behavior with soft-robotics/tactile-array use, and the measured wrench with compliant-control purpose.
gaps.whyUnique: Current items test the mechanisms, dynamic/static limitation, drift, wrench arithmetic and ideal capacitance equation, not these source-listed task roles. A bounded application extension suffices; no universal performance/safety guarantee.

gaps.target: Make operating-environment suitability, controller-interface compatibility and physical size/weight genuine selection constraints, rather than assuming them equal.
gaps.whyUnique: The six current items cover range/error/rate, latency, power/endurance, redundancy and maintenance, but the combined numerical candidates explicitly bypass environment/interface and only test the power component of SWaP. One compact supplied-constraint selection item or extensions can cover these omitted dimensions without redundant arithmetic variants.
